# SoftSpark DSH Orchestrator

> Config-only DSH bundle exposing Claude Code and GitHub Copilot Gemini subscription-backed delegation.

## Primary files

- README.md: setup, native login prerequisites, policy, and removal.
- cordis.patch.yml: host-plane provider registration.
- agent-presets/softspark-orchestrator/agent.cordis.yml: standard-derived tool composition.
- kb/decisions/adr-001-subscription-subagents.md: architecture decision.
- kb/decisions/adr-002-github-copilot-gemini-acp.md: official ACP route and security decision.
- kb/reference/configuration.md: exact configuration contract.
- kb/reference/security.md: trust boundaries and failure policy.
- kb/howto/setup.md: installation guide.
- kb/procedures/: pre-commit, release, and post-release SOPs.

## Hard constraints

- No provider API keys or custom OAuth.
- Native vendor login state remains vendor-owned.
- Claude uses fail-closed `dontAsk` permissions.
- Copilot Gemini uses `permission: reject`, no child tools, no remote features, and a pinned model.
- Direct Google, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Google OAuth, and Gemini API routes are absent.
- DSH compatibility pinned to 0.1.1-rc.2.

## Verified evidence

- 12/12 tests; 100 percent line and 92.59 percent branch coverage.
- Zero source, dependency, SARIF, permission, or lifecycle findings.
- 459 verified registry signatures and 58 attestations.
- Codex-to-Claude Max and Codex-to-Copilot-Gemini delegations complete end to end without provider API keys.
- Current package hash is recorded in `kb/planning/dsh-orchestrator-implementation-plan.md`.
